difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the cone-level two-out-of-three statement for morphisms of cone triangles in the differential graded setting (statement lines 4260-4276). The proof (lines 4278-4319) is a real triangulated-category argument: inverting the first two components through the cone-completion lemma, the reduction to the endomorphism case via the two-out-of-three lemma, and the difference-map trick (c - 1)^2 = 0 from the admissible rows that exhibits 2 - c as the inverse of c. H2: compact, but the reduction logic and the difference trick are genuine content and the statement is a workhorse for the homotopy-category arguments of the chapter.
